description: This PHP class defines a display field for immigration information within the OrangeHRM reporting system. It extends a listable display field and specifies the associated DTO class, entity alias, and the relevant database fields.

classes.name: Immigration
classes.description: Represents a display field for immigration information in reports, extending the ListableDisplayField base class.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field, specifically Dto\Immigration.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used within the context of this display field, here ['immigrationRecord'].

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields relevant to this display field, specifically ['employee.empNumber'].
